_rule_for_register_lenses: subculture_register measures whether a text speaks in a subculture's register in the speaker's own voice: a listed tell deployed natively (Lenin's own theoretical exposition, Stalin's own report) is CP; the same tell used to narrate organizational/administrative history without doctrinal charge (who joined or left which body) is CO; a tell quoted, cited as a title, or named as another group's word is QA. institutional_permeation/intermediary-laundering requires the text to show routing-so-no-principal-is-on-record, not merely name 'civil society' as a stakeholder category -- boilerplate multi-stakeholder language is CO. reference_capture/state-corp-ip-edits requires an edit traced to the org's own IP editing the org's own topic -- a textbook hit is CP. distributed_accountability/authority-to-define-true requires the institution to claim ITS OWN gatekeeping authority over truth, not merely to gesture at 'authoritative sources' for users to consult.
